about: The baked forms (see tools/bake-field.py and docs/design.md). grid: the fine grid the solid is found on, the cells of the field along each side, and the reach of its distances (in the box [-1, 1]). Per field: where its shape comes from and on what terms, the file to read, its format, its up axis, a turn about the vertical (degrees) so that its side faces +z and its front +x, and how many fine cells of gap to close (0: none).
